$comment: Per-slug density applicability, with the evidence behind every value. `check:contract` requires an entry for every component, requires it to match component-manifest.json, and requires a non-empty `evidence` note — a value with nothing behind it is the defect this file exists to prevent (DENSITY-001). See src/contracts/density.ts for what the four values mean and scripts/lib/component-source.mjs for which two of them derivation may produce.
$rules: supported — the family's principal control resolves a density metric: it reads a density-aware CSS variable in its own source, or it renders, as its own root control, a component that does. Derivable when the variable is in this file's source; declared when it arrives through composition.
unsupported — the family owns a metric density should govern (control height, repeated-row rhythm, table cell padding, or the gap between form-field parts) and hardcodes it. A reviewed backlog entry.

not-applicable — the family owns none of those four metrics: it is content-intrinsic (text, glyph, dot, graphic track), author-sized (a size prop in px, an aspect box), pass-through (no metric of its own), or absent from layout altogether.
unknown — reviewed and genuinely undecidable from source. The `evidence` note must say what would settle it.

access-review.evidence: Repeated grant rows at fixed py-2 / py-3 with gap-2.5 — row rhythm that --qx-control-row-height and --qx-control-cell-padding-y exist to govern.

accordion.evidence: Trigger row is py-4 and the panel is pb-4; a disclosure header is a control row whose height should follow --qx-control-height.

action-bar.evidence: Bar padding is py-1.5 with h-4 separators. Toolbar, the same pattern one directory over, sizes its items from --qx-control-height; ActionBar does not.

alert.evidence: Surface padding py-3 with gap-x-3 / gap-y-1, all literal. A message surface should tighten under compact and has nothing to read.

alert-dialog.evidence: p-6 content padding and gap-4 header/footer rhythm are literal.

angle-slider.evidence: The dial is author-sized: a size prop in px (default 80) sets width and height, and the thumb is derived from it (size * 0.16). There is no control height, row or field gap — the caller owns the only dimension.

app-shell.evidence: h-14 application bar and p-4 md:p-6 content gutter are literal; the shell chrome stays put while a compact DataTable inside it shrinks.

aspect-ratio.evidence: A ratio box: it sizes from the caller's width and its aspect prop. No control height, row, cell or field gap.

audit-event.evidence: Repeated event rows at py-2 with space-y-3 between them — list rhythm, not content.

availability-grid.evidence: Grid cells are h-7 with py-1 / py-1.5 labels; a time grid is exactly the row-height / cell-padding-y case.

avatar.evidence: An author-sized image frame on its own size axis; a portrait's diameter is not layout rhythm.

badge.evidence: Inline text decoration: py-0.5 / text-xs, height entirely from its own line box. It has no control height to compress and does not align to control rhythm.

banner.evidence: py-2.5 bar padding and a size-7 dismiss control, both literal.

blockquote.evidence: Typographic block — border, inline padding and italics. Density publishes no type metric.

breadcrumb.evidence: Trail items are interactive with literal gap-1 / gap-1.5 and size-3.5..size-5 affordances; no control height is read.

button.evidence: Default and icon sizes read var(--qx-component-button-height), which resolves to --qx-density-control-height. The explicit xs/sm/lg sizes are literal by design — an explicit size is a caller's decision, not a density one.

button-group.evidence: A pass-through fieldset — border-0 p-0 plus interior border-radius overrides. It contributes no metric of its own; the buttons the caller puts inside it are the density-aware part.

calendar.evidence: Day cells are sized from a private --cell-size and the nav buttons are h-8; neither is on the density scale.

callout.evidence: p-4 surface padding and gap-3 are literal.

card.evidence: p-3/p-4, py-3/py-4 and pb-3/pb-4 across header, content and footer, all literal. The most-composed surface in the library and the one a compact page would most visibly need.

carousel.evidence: pt-4 dot rail and literal control placement; the Buttons it renders are one part of the family, not its principal control.

chart.evidence: Legend swatches h-2.5/h-3, tooltip rows py-1.5, and the data-table fallback rows are all literal — the fallback is a table, so cell-padding-y applies to it directly.

chart-presets.evidence: SVG geometry only: aspect-square frames and a sparkline path. No padding, no rows, no controls.

checkbox.evidence: The only density-relevant metric is the size-4 (16px) box and its gap-3 to the label. Shrinking a 16px box under compact pushes the hit target further below the 24px WCAG 2.5.8 minimum it is already relying on a label-click exception for. Settled by a design ruling: may compact reduce target size, or should it compress only the label gap? Source cannot answer either way.

checkbox-card.evidence: p-4 card padding with gap-3, literal.

chip.evidence: h-6/h-7/h-8 private size axis. Button resolved the same question by making its default size density-resolved and leaving explicit sizes literal; Chip's default is literal.

clipboard.evidence: CopyButton pins size="sm" on Button, which is h-7 — Button's density-resolved height is only on the default and icon sizes, so this opts out.

close-button.evidence: Defaults to size="icon-sm" (size-7). Button's density-resolved height is on default/icon only, so the default CloseButton never moves.

code-block.evidence: p-3 frame and py-1.5 per line, literal; a code listing's line rhythm is the row-height case.

collapsible.evidence: Three unstyled Base UI wrappers with no className at all. Nothing to size.

color-swatch.evidence: A colour sample tile, size-4..size-8. Its size is a perceptual requirement — how much colour a reader needs to judge a hue — not layout rhythm. ColorPicker's trigger, which is a control, already reads --qx-control-height.

command-palette.evidence: h-12 search row and py-2 result rows, literal — a palette is a list of rows.

comment-thread.evidence: min-h-12 avatar gutter and space-y-1..space-y-4 thread rhythm, literal.

container.evidence: Inline axis only: max-width plus px gutters. Density publishes no width or inline-gutter metric and a page's measure is not a density concern.

context-menu.evidence: Item rows are py-1 inside p-1 popup padding; menu items are controls and menubar (same pattern) reads --qx-control-height.

currency-input.evidence: Renders Input as its only sized element; Input's height is h-[var(--qx-component-input-height)]. The currency symbol is absolutely positioned and the ps-7 inset is inline-axis only.

data-state.evidence: p-4 / p-6 / p-10 state panels with an h-10 action row, literal.

data-table.evidence: Consumes the density context directly (useDensity) and re-publishes it as data-qx-density on the table root, so the row-height estimate the virtualiser uses and the rendered rhythm agree.

date-picker.evidence: Delegates day sizing to Calendar's private --cell-size and pins Button size on its trigger; nothing on the density scale.

date-time-picker.evidence: p-3 panel plus Calendar's --cell-size day grid, literal.

description-list.evidence: gap-y-3 between repeated term/detail pairs — row rhythm on a key-value grid.

dialog.evidence: p-6 content padding and gap-4 section rhythm, literal.

diff-viewer.evidence: py-0.5 per diff line — line rhythm, which is the row-height case.

drawer.evidence: pt-2 header and grab-handle chrome, literal.

dropdown-menu.evidence: Item rows py-1 inside p-1 popup padding. Menubar, the same menu pattern, reads --qx-control-height; this does not.

editable.evidence: The read-mode preview is min-h-9 (36px) while the edit-mode Input is h-[var(--qx-component-input-height)] (32px default, 28px compact). The two disagree at every density, and switching modes visibly jumps.

empty-state.evidence: py-12 block padding with size-11 icon frame, literal.

feed.evidence: Repeated feed items at p-4 with gap-3 — row rhythm.

field.evidence: Reads var(--qx-control-field-gap) for the gap between label, control and description.

file-card.evidence: p-3 card padding with a size-8 thumbnail, literal.

file-type-icon.evidence: A single lucide glyph at size-5. Icons are on the icon scale (tokens/primitive/icon.json), not the density scale.

file-upload.evidence: p-6 dropzone and p-2 file rows, literal; the file list is a row list.

filter-bar.evidence: The Input and Combobox it renders are density-resolved, but the bar's own gap-1 / gap-2 / pt-1 chrome and size-3.5 affordances are literal, so the bar height does not follow its controls.

floating-window.evidence: py-2 title bar and p-3 body, literal.

focus-trap.evidence: A bare div with no className; the component is the containment behaviour.

form.evidence: gap-6 section and gap-2 action stacks are literal, while Field — the thing they stack — reads --qx-control-field-gap. The form outgrows its own fields under compact.

highlight.evidence: Wraps matched substrings in <mark> with inline-axis padding only. Its height is the line box.

icon.evidence: Sets the size and stroke of a lucide component from the icon scale. No box of its own.

icon-button.evidence: Renders Button with size="icon" by default, which is size-[var(--qx-component-button-height)] — the density-resolved control height. The whole component is that button.

json-tree.evidence: Repeated node rows with literal gap-1 and p-2; a tree is a row list.

kbd.evidence: Inline text decoration for a key glyph; height is its own line box.

label.evidence: Inline text with a gap-2 to its own trailing icons. The label-to-control gap is Field's, and Field reads --qx-control-field-gap.

link.evidence: Inline anchor; the sm/md/lg axis is font size, and the gap-1 is to its own icon. No control height.

listbox.evidence: Option rows are py-1.5 inside p-1; Select's own listbox reads --qx-control-height, this one does not.

logo-uploader.evidence: Renders density-resolved Input/Button but frames them with its own literal preview chrome and gap-2.

marquee.evidence: Inline-axis ticker. The only spacing is the caller's gap prop in px; no block metric.

mask-input.evidence: Renders a single Input as its root; height is h-[var(--qx-component-input-height)], density-resolved.

master-detail.evidence: Two h-full panes with gap-0 p-0. Both children are author-sized; the component contributes no rhythm.

mention-input.evidence: Suggestion rows py-1.5 in a max-h-48 popup, literal.

meter.evidence: An h-2 graphic track. A bar's thickness is a graphic weight, not a control height — shrinking it under compact would make the reading harder, not denser.

notification.evidence: p-4 surface padding and a size-7 close control, literal.

notification-center.evidence: Notification rows at py-2.5 / py-2 inside a max-h-96 list — row rhythm.

notification-preference-matrix.evidence: A real table with py-2 / py-3 / pb-2 cells: --qx-control-cell-padding-y is the metric for exactly this and Table already reads it.

number-formatter.evidence: A span of Intl-formatted text. No box.

org-chart.evidence: p-2 node cards and pt-4 / py-2 rank spacing, literal.

otp-input.evidence: h-12 digit boxes, literal, while the Field it sits in reads --qx-control-field-gap.

overflow-list.evidence: The overflow trigger is h-6 and item gaps are literal, so the row height does not follow the controls it measures.

page-header.evidence: gap-3 / gap-1 / gap-2 title, description and action stacks are literal. It has no fixed height, but the block rhythm is the part a compact page would tighten.

pagination.evidence: py-2 bar padding and literal control gaps; the page buttons pin their own size.

pagination-bar.evidence: A deprecated re-export of Pagination — same component, so necessarily the same value.

password-input.evidence: Renders Input as the field; height is h-[var(--qx-component-input-height)]. The reveal toggle is absolutely positioned and contributes no height.

password-strength-meter.evidence: h-1 strength segments — graphic weight, same as Progress and Meter.

portal.evidence: Re-export of the primitive; renders its children into another node and no element of its own.

presence-indicator.evidence: An 8-12px status dot (size-2..size-3). Below every density metric and sized to stay visible against an avatar.

preview-card.evidence: p-3 body and h-32 media frame, literal.

progress.evidence: An h-2 graphic track. Same reasoning as Meter.

progress-circle.evidence: Author-sized diameter — the sm/md/lg axis and the svg width/height come from one number. No control height, no rhythm.

qr-code.evidence: Author-sized square. The module grid derives from the size prop; density has no say in how large a scannable code must be.

radio-card.evidence: p-4 card padding with gap-3, literal.

radio-group.evidence: Same as Checkbox: a size-4 control glyph with a gap-3 label gap, and the same WCAG 2.5.8 target-size collision. Needs the same ruling.

rating.evidence: Stars are size-3.5 / size-5 / size-7 interactive targets. Whether the default 20px star shrinks under compact runs into the same target-size question as Checkbox, and the size axis does not say which end density should move. Settled by the same design ruling.

reaction-bar.evidence: Reaction pills are h-6 / size-8 with p-1.5, literal — they are controls in a row.

resizable.evidence: A 1px splitter plus an optional h-4 w-3 grip glyph. The panels are sized by the caller (or by drag), and divider thickness is chrome, not rhythm.

rich-text-editor.evidence: p-1 toolbar and min-h-40 body are literal; the Toggle it renders for each mark does read --qx-control-height, so the toolbar is taller than its own buttons need under compact.

rolling-number.evidence: A span of tabular digits. The animation moves them; nothing sizes them.

schedule-calendar.evidence: h-24 day cells and py-8 hour rows, literal — the densest grid in the library and the one row-height was written for.

scroll-area.evidence: A 10px scrollbar track and thumb over author-sized content. Scrollbar thickness is chrome.

security-item.evidence: Repeated rows at p-4 with a size-9 icon frame — row rhythm.

segmented-control.evidence: h-8 / h-9 / h-10 private size axis with p-1 track padding; the default size is literal rather than density-resolved.

select.evidence: Default-size trigger reads var(--qx-control-height); data-[size=sm] is literal h-7.

separator.evidence: A 1px rule. Its one dimension is a hairline and the other is inherited.

sheet.evidence: p-4 surface padding and gap-4 section rhythm, literal.

skeleton.evidence: A placeholder box whose dimensions are supplied by the caller to match whatever it stands in for — including a density-aware component, in which case the caller passes the density-aware size.

skip-nav.evidence: sr-only until focused, then a position: fixed overlay. It never participates in the page's vertical rhythm, so there is nothing for its height to align to.

slider.evidence: The interactive row has no height of its own (h-1 track, size-3 thumb) and min-h-40 fixes the vertical variant, so a slider never aligns to the control rhythm of the fields around it. Toggle solved the same alignment problem by reading --qx-control-height.

spinner.evidence: A lucide glyph at size-4..size-8, on the icon scale.

spoiler.evidence: A -webkit-line-clamp on text plus a text-only toggle with no height. Density publishes no line-clamp or type metric.

stat.evidence: p-4 tile padding with literal gap-0.5 / gap-1.5 / gap-2 stacks.

status-pill.evidence: Composes Badge with a size-1.5 dot; inline text decoration, same reasoning as Badge.

stepper.evidence: size-7 step markers and gap-3 connectors, literal.

switch.evidence: Track and thumb come from --qx-component-switch-* , which is a private scale, not a density one. Whether compact should shrink a switch (and take the target below 24px) or leave it and tighten only the row is a design ruling, not a source fact.

table.evidence: Reads var(--qx-control-row-height) and var(--qx-control-cell-padding-y) — the only component that consumes both row metrics.

table-of-contents.evidence: py-1 on every repeated nav row — row rhythm.

tag-input.evidence: min-h-8 field shell and h-6 tags are literal, and the min-h-8 (32px) disagrees with the density-resolved input height it is imitating at both comfortable (36px) and compact (28px).

textarea.evidence: min-h-16 and py-2 are literal, while its sibling Input reads --qx-component-input-height. Two fields in the same form stop matching under compact.

time-picker.evidence: Pins size="sm" on every SelectTrigger, which is data-[size=sm]:h-7 — Select's density-resolved height is on the default size only, so this opts out.

time-range-picker.evidence: p-1.5 panel and gap-0.5 segment chrome, literal.

time-since.evidence: A <time> element of formatted text. No box.

timeline.evidence: Repeated items at pb-6 with size-2.5 markers — row rhythm.

timer.evidence: Renders Button size="sm" (h-7) for its controls, opting out of the density-resolved default size; the digit display is typographic.

toast.evidence: py-3 / p-1 surface padding and gap-3 rhythm, literal.

toggle.evidence: Reads var(--qx-control-height) for both height and min-width.

toggle-tip.evidence: Trigger is pinned to buttonVariants({ size: "icon-sm" }) — size-7, literal, and not overridable through a size prop.

tour.evidence: p-4 step card with gap-2 / mt-4 rhythm, literal.

tree-view.evidence: Item rows are py-1 with gap-1.5 — a tree is a row list, and row-height is the metric for it.

typography.evidence: The type scale: font sizes, line heights and block margins. Density publishes control, row, cell and field-gap metrics and no type metric; compressing type is a separate axis with its own readability constraints.

visually-hidden.evidence: Clipped out of layout entirely. It has no rendered metrics at all, by definition.
